title: Extrapulmonary ARDS, stiff chest wall, PC
summary: Recruitable lungs with a stiff chest wall (Ecw 12). Pressure control with the same plateau delivers a safer transpulmonary pressure than the airway numbers suggest.
objectives: Compare airway ΔP with ΔPL when the chest wall takes a large share.
